candidates: All 256 input-qualified fields from prior label-blind timing/coverage/history/replay audit; all 522 accounted for. No selection using extreme improvements or magnitude development outcomes.
qualification_reuse: Same feature values, decision timestamps and valid target population. Inherited full-source availability and prior-only history checks plus bounded numerical replays. Provisional source certification limitations remain.
model: Conditional median regression: minimize sum(abs(y - (b0+b1*Z+b2*M))) over the original training rows; no penalty, interactions or tuning
preprocessing: Training median-fill finite X; training mean and population std of filled X; unscaled missing flag M. Reuse verified standalone preprocessing constants and independently rebuild them.
prediction: max(0,b0+b1*Z+b2*M); fixed nonnegative projection because magnitude is nonnegative. Save raw and clipped prediction diagnostics.
objective: MAE, matched to the training-median baseline; RMSE/mean baseline is a separate unrun track
implementation: Sparse linear program min sum(u+v), B*beta+u-v=y, beta free, u/v>=0, B=[1,Z,M]; scipy linprog highs-ipm
certificate: Persist dual lambda. Check |lambda|<=1, B.T@lambda≈0 and primal loss≈y.T@lambda. Normalized dual stationarity <=1e-6; mean duality gap <=1e-5 log bps. Independent replay verifies every model without extra fits.
no_retries: Record any failed fit, no changed settings; preserve every requested outcome
monthly: Same 13 development months and original rows; report missing/present errors and prediction variation
uncertainty: Paired 7d/14d blocks, 2000 draws, seed48+days; nominal intervals and centered max-standardized simultaneous 95% bands across all fitted features
labels: NO_MAE_GAIN if MAE>=M0; otherwise EXPLORATORY_MAE_GAIN unless majority months better, both simultaneous upper bounds<0, and nonconstant development prediction, then DEVELOPMENT_MAGNITUDE_LEAD
concentration: For top score and any development leads: fixed March, March+August, and largest one/two contribution-month exclusions; diagnostic only
flat_predictions: Flag constant development X or forecasts; improved constant error can reflect a historical level shift, not within-period discrimination.
next_stage: This run completes baseline replay and standalone stage. Only qualified magnitude evidence determines any later controlled addition; no automatic interaction/tree expansion.
exposure: Previously exposed development, no verified untouched holdout; simultaneous bands do not undo earlier research exposure.
